newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end sharply up on Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end sharply up on Dow rally.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures surged to a bullish close on Tuesday, fuelled largely by the Dow's record finish for the second straight session.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract gapped sharply up at the open on the back of strong gains in Chicago while Japan and SIMEX Nikkei markets were closed for a holiday on Monday.
The December Nikkei closed 30 points off its intra-day high of 21,390 against a previous settlement at 20,880.

"The market's very strong. We could easily see 21,500," said a dealer with a European house, adding that the market was likely to consolidate around that level before heading towards its next target of 21,700.
He said the December Nikkei would be supported at 21,300 initially and at the more crucial level of 21,000.
A Japanese bank dealer said the the market was also being underpinned by the prospect of a lower house election in Japan next month. "Usually, the market goes up ahead of an election," he said.
